title: MiauCraft
description: cobblemon server with cobbleverse modpack and way more!
body:
🐾 Welcome to Miaucraft 🐾
The Ultimate Fresh Start for Cobblemon Trainers!

Launched today, Miaucraft is a brand-new Cobblemon experience built for players who want a smooth, modern, and grief-free journey. We’ve combined the best of Pokémon with the best of Minecraft survival, powered by the industry-leading Cobbleverse modpack.

🚀 Why Miaucraft?
We aren't just another Cobblemon server. We focus on performance and player experience:

Powered by Cobbleverse (Modrinth): We use the highly optimized Cobbleverse pack to ensure high FPS, beautiful animations, and a sleek UI that feels like a professional RPG.

A Brand New World: Since we launched today, the map is fresh, the economy is balanced, and all the best base locations are still available!

Player-Driven Economy (GTS): Our Global Trade System allows you to buy, sell, and auction your Pokémon or rare items with ease. Become the server’s top tycoon!

Ironclad Protection (FLAN): Sleep easy knowing your builds are safe. Our FLAN claim system is easy to use and 100% grief-proof.

Quality of Life (QoL): We’ve added the essentials to make your life easier, including /home, /tpa, and custom starter kits to get you into the action immediately.
